_readme: Each case is a scanned product (by query or barcode) plus HUMAN labels for the alternatives Mieux returns, keyed by barcode: substitute (true/false), cheaper (true/false), better_quality (true/false), good_value (true/false), price_ok (true/false). Labels are written by a person, ideally two reviewers. Run: python scripts/benchmark.py --template to list candidates to label, python scripts/benchmark.py to score.
